checked_profile.summary: Online stock and fund investing with account-service and transfer fees to check.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Stocks and ETFs
facts.text: $0 online commissions. For clients with less than $1 million in qualifying assets, broker-assisted trades generally add $25.

facts.label: Options
facts.text: The standard fee below $1 million in qualifying assets is $1 per contract. Higher asset tiers have limited annual fee waivers; eligibility conditions apply.

facts.label: Mutual funds
facts.text: Online Vanguard and eligible no-transaction-fee funds have $0 transaction commissions. Below $1 million in qualifying assets, other transaction-fee funds cost $20 per trade. Fund expenses and redemption fees can apply.

facts.label: Account and transfer fees
facts.text: A $25 annual service fee may apply; qualifying electronic delivery is one waiver route. A full transfer or account closure may cost $100, with stated exceptions. The source schedule is effective July 10, 2026.
